Program Overview McKesson's Intern program is designed to provide: • A real-life working environment • A solid foundation of experience and hopeful offer of full-time employment • A cohort experience with other interns Consistent senior leadership exposure and learning experiences. • We are looking for candidates who have: • Willingness to learn, develop, and contribute to a fun, demanding, fast-paced environment. • Self-starter that brings both interpersonal skills abilities to identify a problem then solve it. Passion and enthusiasm for healthcare and our customers' success • Work Term: Summer 2026- May 4th through August 28th Location: Mississauga, ON, CAN - 2300 Meadowvale Blvd (Hybrid) About the Role McKesson Canada is seeking a Summer Intern to join our CRM & Marketing Solutions team within McKesson Technology. This internship is an excellent opportunity for a student who is passionate about technology, problem solving, and learning how enterprise platforms support customer care and sales operations in a healthcare environment. As a Summer Intern, you will gain hands on exposure to Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, working alongside experienced Salesforce administrators, developers, and business partners. You'll contribute to real initiatives while building foundational skills in CRM platforms, agile delivery, and enterprise IT practices. This role is designed as a learning experience, with mentorship, structured onboarding, and meaningful work throughout the summer. What You'll Do With guidance and support from the team, you will: • Assist with Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud configuration activities (e.g., fields, page layouts, reports, basic automations) • Support testing and user acceptance activities for Salesforce enhancements and releases • Help document business processes, system configurations, and user guides • Participate in incident and request triage, learning how enterprise support models work • Assist with data quality and reporting tasks, including reviewing dashboards and basic analytics • Collaborate with cross functional teams including IT, business analysts, and product owners • Participate in agile ceremonies such as team stand ups and sprint reviews Learn how Salesforce supports customer care, sales, and operational teams across McKesson Canada • What You'll Learn • Practical experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud • How large organizations deliver and support enterprise CRM platforms • Exposure to agile delivery, change management, and governance • Professional skills such as communication, collaboration, and problem solving in a corporate environment Insight into technology careers within healthcare and pharmaceutical distribution • Why Join McKesson Canada • Gain real world experience at a global healthcare leader • Work on meaningful systems that support patient care and customer experience • Learn from experienced technology professionals and mentors • Build skills that prepare you for future co-op, internship, or new grad roles Inclusive, supportive, and student friendly work environment • We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. Our Base Pay Range for this position $17.69 - $27.74 Job Requirements Who You Are You are a motivated student who is eager to learn and curious about how technology enables business outcomes.
